checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=29 breakdowns=1 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.93 tightness=1.06 base_volume_vs_leg=0.91 base_volume_vs_avg=1.05
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 29 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base gave back 0.93 of the leg; the base ranged wider than the sessions before it

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 9.1% vs its 20-SMA, 10.9% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 0 of 1 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The mechanical grade is A but two recorded FAIL checks — C (base of 29 sessions, giveback of 0.93 of the leg, tightness 1.06) and VOL (volume rank 10 of 60, only 1.38x the 50-session average against a required 1.5x for a base over 21 sessions) — are genuine quality defects, not proxies. The chart confirms the base region (shaded box from early September through mid-October) is wide and declining, with multiple overlapping red and green bars spanning roughly $33–$40, and the giveback of nearly the entire prior leg is visible as the price retraced from ~$39 back to ~$33 before recovering. The signal bar itself is honest — closes near the high with good range expansion — but the loose, deep base and insufficient volume for a long consolidation cap this at B.
claude.key_risk: A base that gave back 93% of the prior leg and ran 29 sessions is structurally weak; any failure to hold the burst close would confirm the base was not orderly enough to support follow-through.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the signal close of $38.65 by more than 1% or if the first 30 minutes show a fade back below the prior day's close near $36.44.
